promptBase:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single full-body NPC illustration / transparent idle sprite for the Korean life-simulation game Oneuldo.
Input image 1 is ONLY the art direction reference: the ACTUAL playable character sprite. Match its delicate warm dark-gray linework, modest anime/storybook facial features, soft flat color shading, restrained desaturated everyday palette and long slim limbs. Adult proportions about 5.5 to 6 heads tall, as in this exact reference; NOT chibi, NOT a big head or stubby body, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D. Same illustrator and same world. Do not copy the reference person's identity or clothes.
Exactly ONE person, full body from hair to soles, facing straight forward in a natural neutral standing idle pose. Arms relaxed at sides, both hands and both complete shoes visible and separate, subtle friendly expression. Flat front camera, no perspective foreshortening, centered vertical figure, feet on a common baseline. Leave a small clear margin all around; no cropped hair or feet.
Output one portrait PNG, preferably 1024x1536. Background: actual transparent alpha if supported. If true alpha is unavailable, use a PERFECTLY SOLID FLAT CHROMA MAGENTA #FF00FF backdrop for clean sprite keying, identical RGB at every background pixel. Never draw a transparency checker pattern. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, background gradient or texture, border, writing, watermark or multiple poses. No magenta anywhere on the person. The character must be crisply readable at a small in-game size.
